import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Div680 {
    static int n, mod, offset;
    static int[][][] dp;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextInt();
        offset = n * (n - 1);
        dp = new int[2][n + 1][2 * offset + 1];
        // base case i = n
        for (int done = 0; done < 2; done++) {
            for (int diff = -offset; diff <= offset; diff++) {
                dp[done][n][diff + offset] = (diff > 0) ? 1 : 0;
            }
        }
        // compute for i from n-1 down to 0
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int rem = n - i;
            for (int done = 0; done < 2; done++) {
                for (int diff = -offset; diff <= offset; diff++) {
                    int ans = 0;
                    for (int l = 0; l < rem; l++) {
                        for (int r = (done == 1) ? 0 : l; r < rem; r++) {
                            int newDiff = diff + l - r;
                            if (newDiff >= -offset && newDiff <= offset) {
                                ans += dp[done | (l < r ? 1 : 0)][i + 1][newDiff + offset];
                                ans %= mod;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    dp[done][i][diff + offset] = ans;
                }
            }
        }
        // compute dp2 iteratively
        long[] dp2 = new long[n];
        dp2[n - 1] = 0;
        for (int i = n - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
            long ans = (n - i) * 1L * dp2[i + 1] % mod;
            int rem = n - i;
            for (int l = 0; l < rem; l++) {
                for (int r = l + 1; r < rem; r++) {
                    int diff = l - r;
                    ans += dp[1][i + 1][diff + offset];
                    ans %= mod;
                }
            }
            dp2[i] = ans;
        }
        pw.println(dp2[0]);
        pw.flush();
    }

    static class Scanner {
        StringTokenizer st;
        BufferedReader br;
        public Scanner(InputStream s) {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(s));
        }
        public String next() throws IOException {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens())
                st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            return st.nextToken();
        }
        public int nextInt() throws IOException {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }
    }
}
